notes.title: What's next for Under the Bed?
notes.content:
First of all, a big thank you to those who bought the game. This is my first game on Steam and it's heartwarming that some people are taking the time to play it.

Now let's talk about the next updates.

First of all, your feedback is important. If you come across any bugs, or even suggestions for the game, I'll be happy to read them and discuss them with you.

About chapter 2 of the game. The second chapter will be FREE, it will simply be an update of the game with the option to play chapter 2, I don't want to make you pay again when the story isn't finished ahah.

For upcoming features: 
- Bug fixes
- Addition of an endless runner mode (Dream 3), where you can see your score and those of others.
- Finally, the last feature would be to add multiplayer, but here I need your help: What kind of multiplayer mode would you like to see on this game? Tell me in the comments, your opinion is important.

Thanks again and see you soon for more information!

Lucas
